title: Choice of a thin level band of small measure
statement: Let μ, ν be measures on ℝ^P (Borel σ-algebra), C ⊆ ℝ^P a measurable set with μ(C) < ∞ and ν(C) < ∞, f : ℝ^P → ℝ continuous, t ∈ ℝ with μ{x : f(x) = t} = 0, and δ > 0. Then there is ε > 0 such that μ(C ∩ {t − ε ≤ f ≤ t}) < δ and ν(C ∩ {t − ε < f < t}) < δ (inequalities in [0, ∞], with δ read as ENNReal.ofReal δ).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (C : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (t δ : ℝ), MeasurableSet C → μ C < ∞ → ν C < ∞ → Continuous f → μ {x | f x = t} = 0 → 0 < δ → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ μ (C ∩ {x | t - ε ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ t}) < ENNReal.ofReal δ ∧ ν (C ∩ {x | t - ε < f x ∧ f x < t}) < ENNReal.ofReal δ
